title: Koopman-based surrogate modeling for reinforcement-learning-control of Rayleigh-Benard convection
summary: Training reinforcement learning (RL) agents to control fluid dynamics systems is computationally expensive due to the high cost of direct numerical simulations (DNS) of the governing equations. Surrogate models offer a promising alternative by approximating the dynamics at a fraction of the computational cost, but their feasibility as training environments for RL is limited by distribution shifts, as policies induce state distributions not covered by the surrogate training data.
